title: offlineimap3-git package broken, assumes setup.py
body: the offlineimap3-git package assumes the source for offlineimap3 has a setup.py file. the upstream has since moved to using pyproject.toml. i made a patch to offlineimap3-git aur package that switches to building using pyproject.toml. it now builds for me. i'm hoping i can get the attention of the author, Pi-Yueh Chuan, to fix this in the AUR package. i would post a comment to the package page, but i can't make an account on AUR because of the recent malicious updates. also, i've never made a patch to AUR before, so it's plausible i'm doing it wrong. if so, let me know!
